Pets provide increasingly beneficial buffs gradually as you use them. There are 5 pets but you can only use one pet at a time. Pets can be obtained right from the first trip (low but highest chance). The magnitudes of their buffs increase, or they increase in effectiveness as you level them up. Note that they are preserved when you prestige or they are permanent.

The maximum level of a pet is 100.

Navigation[]

Pet page without selection is obtained via social -> my profile -> pet. This page contains your current pet XP per trip (PPT), the pets you have and what they buff, their pet levels and extent of XP into the level.

Pet page with selection is obtained via menu -> pet. The page contains all of the above but also buttons underneath to switch between pets and to choose to not use a pet (deselect pet).

Command Usage[]

The common usage is /pet [selection]. If the selection parameter is empty the main pet page is shown. The type parameter should not have spaces in between, and capitalization does not matter. If the selection parameter is a valid type of pet that you have obtained, the bot will change the type of pet to you. If the type parameter is a valid type of pet that you don't have, the bot displays an error message stating that you don't have that pet. If the type parameter is anything else, the main pet page will be displayed. If you type none in the selection parameter the bot will automatically deselect the pet for you such that you will no longer use a pet.

Message for Obtaining Pet[]

This appears as a separate message with the bolded caption of RARE FIND!.

It displays which pet you got. If you have not received the pet before, a tip message of "Begin using this pet with the /pet command." will be displayed. If you obtain a duplicate pet, a tip message that states the amount of pet XP the pet gained will be displayed instead.

There are 5 types of pets available. The below shows the maximum buffs each pet can have at pet level 100. Notice the major and minor buffs for each pet.

Pet Specifics[]

Pet Chance[]

Pets are very rare, and if you find them the pet will be labelled as "rare find" as a separate embed (from fishing). This roughly corresponds to 1 pet per early prestige. You have a 1/10000 per trip chance by default of getting a pet. Prestiging increases the chance by 3% compounded. If you cannot get your first pet within 10,000 trips you receive a 50% pet chance boost (to 1/6667 without prestige). If you can't get a pet within 15,000 trips you will receive a 200% pet chance boost (to 1/3333 without prestige). All pets have pretty much the same chance of obtaining even accounting for complex mechanics in rerolling.

Think of it as rolling die. Roll a pool of 1000 dice and remove all with one facing the top. The expected amount of die left are roughly ⅚(1000). Roll these die again and repeat the same procedure. Each time ⅙ of all remaining die are taken away and ⅚ remain. This gives the expected amount of die left after k iterations to be ⅚^k. This is the same as people not having a pet by k trips, except the decay constant is different.

Obviously every trip it rolls RNG to determine whether you get the pet. You have a 1/10000 per trip chance by default of getting a pet. Prestiging increases the chance by 3% compounded so at P110 you have a 0.2583% chance of getting a pet per trip. If you cannot get your first pet within 10,000 trips (happens for 36% of people) you receive a 50% pet chance boost (to 1/6667). If you can't get a pet within 15,000 trips you will receive a 200% pet chance boost (to 1/3333). All pets have pretty much the same chance of obtaining even including the reroll codes.

Pet Chance Statistics[]

Here are the three formulae for the percentage of people not getting a pet within x trips.

(x = trip, multiply by 1.03^p for prestige p)

(1≤x≤10000): 0.9999^x

[The below is for the first pet only]

Formula (10001≤x≤15000): 0.9999^10000 · 0.99985^x

Formula (x≥15001): 0.9999^10000 · 0.99985^5000 · 0.9997^x

Next up the statistics for the number of trips you take to get the first pet, accounted for prestige.

Mean for 1st pet: 8050-8150 (accounting for rate of prestige)

Mean for other pets varies heavily with prestige, but for intra prestige conditions the chance is purely (0.999^x)(1.03^p). If prestige increases and a pet isn't still obtained the chance is higher than that of the original prestige but lower than that of the highest prestige reached.

Lower quartile: 2876 / Median: 6930 / Upper quartile: 12500

For the next pets the mean is exactly 10000/1.03^p, and the median uses the same method of calculation.

Pet Buffs[]

When a pet is used it gets a certain amount of pet xp. The average pet xp is written on the pet page. You need pet xp to level pets similar to how you level up normally. The XP increases each level and the maximum pet level is 100, which you need roughly 10,000,000 pet xp to get. This table shows the pet buff per level of pet in +% (x= level of pet):

Maximum buff +85% +63.75% +25.5% +21.25%
Pet buff for each level 10+0.75x 7.5+0.5625x 3+0.225x 2.5+0.1875x

Duplicates[]

You can get duplicate pets, transferred to a certain amount of pet xp. You get 4 digits of xp if it rolls a pet that you have already got. Note that the xp (pet level) for each level is different with level 100, with 5000-9999 pet xp being much more common than the rest.

The first five pets are never duplicates, the game will try very hard to get you a pet. Pets reroll 4 times until you get a pet according to a definite order. Direct quote from Saltspreader about the reroll mechanic: "basically in human terms, say you just have the tuna, in the codes mind that means you have the last pet in the list - it will try to find a random pet you don't have, this just happens by grabbing a random pet, if that pet happens to be one you own (tuna), it tries again, it does this up to 5 times and if you own every pet it tries to give you it simply gives you the first one you don't have (starting at the puffer). but technically puffer would be a tiny amount more common than the others, like 0.1%". If your first pet is not a puffer, you have a 25.024% chance of receiving a puffer on the 2nd pet since you have a 0.032% chance of getting 5 tunas in a row. The order of pets in reroll is unknown, but it is guessed to be puffer > dolphin > zebrafish > axolotl >tuna.

Pet XP per trip[]

Pet XP per trip (ppt) is not well understood. The base ppt is ten. Before P10, each prestige increment increases ppt by 1, and each increment of biome increases ppt by 2, so the general formula for that is 10+p+2(x-1). Both figures do not hold for higher prestiges, and different biomes give you different increases in ppt. The general trend is that higher biomes give you a higher increase (slope not just value) in xp with the function rising in at least O(n). The maximum ppt you can get is 122 as of now. The theoretical limit is said to be 127 or 255. Also the above only guesses the average ppt, the actual amount of ppt is variable and not investigated as of now.
